notes.title: Silmaris Patch Notes
notes.content:
These patches correct the various problems that have occurred since the release of the game. 

1.1.8/9
- minor bugs (fixed)

1.1.6/7
- Two saved games available after a defeat
- missing translations (fixed)
- minor bugs (fixed)

1.1.5
- Gem event not displayed (fixed)
- Options button, wrong text (fixed)
- Minor bugs (fixed)

1.1.4
- minor bugs (fixed)
- Fire event fixed

1.1.3
- Graphic bug in chest scrollview (fixed)
- Wrong behavior in a critical event (hot fix)

1.1.2
- Bug in the councilor leaving event (fixed)

1.1.1
- Temporary suspension of an event for correction and improvement
- minor bugs (fixed)

1.1
- Some wrong odds displayed on missions (fixed)
- Minor bugs in some events (fixed)
- Support for extra large displays (G9 Odyssey)
- Added Social buttons (home screen)
- Added Welcome popup (home screen)
- Reroll to get dice cost now 1 Fate Point (game)

1.0.2
- Added full in-game Steam leaderboard (Steam Overlay)
- Minor bugs fixed

notes.title: Silmaris: Dice Kingdom comes out on December 3rd!
notes.content:
Great news !
Silmaris: Dice Kingdom comes out on December 3rd!

Are you ready to conquer kingdoms?
Will you declare war or forge alliances?
 
🎲 Roll the dice to rule them all! 🎲

Watch the livestream on the Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293120/Silmaris_Dice_Kingdom/

notes.title: Announcing Silmaris: Dice Kingdom
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/582aefedf446fd671498187cb4cdd944c287bda0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Roll the dice for Silmaris![/h1]

Have you ever dream of ruling your kingdom... with dice? That's exactly what Silmaris offer in this medieval narrative-driven management game. 

Take the helm of the fallen city of Thylla and restore the lost power of your kingdom by subduing the other monarchs in the valley. Choose and use your advisors wisely to wage war or form alliances, develop trade and explore the world, or spy on your enemies and conspire to overthrow the other rulers!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1293120/ss_5e9a8e1b12a20c3d7519a0d164045dd730f79962.1920x1080.jpg[/img]
[h1]Roll the dice for Silmaris![/h1]

Each new game features a different story packed with twists and turns. React to events and make the right decisions when fate thwarts your reign… and as you prepare to face the greatest threat the world has ever known!

Silmaris: Dice Kingdom will be available this year on PC (Win, Mac, Linux).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293120/
